pages.title: TES5 Skyrim: The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller

parser_requirements: Heading text identifying a speaker starts a new dialogue turn.
Parenthetical narration is retained as transcript context and tagged separately from spoken dialogue.
A player prompt should be attached to the NPC answer it elicits while remaining independently searchable.
Group speakers remain group speakers unless the source explicitly attributes individual lines.
Translations supplied in dialogue remain linked to the original-language passage.
Notes and written messages encountered during a quest are typed as embedded_written_text rather than NPC speech.
